title.ca: gos · obrir · caixa / galleda / peces → caure

moments.evidence: Una peça grossa reposa damunt d’una tapa corredissa. A través del frontal transparent de la caixa es veu una galleda baixa a sota de la peça.
Estira la tapa lateralment. Una vora fixa de la caixa reté la peça mentre la tapa deixa una obertura sota seu.
La peça és a la galleda, directament sota l’obertura. La tapa queda desplaçada.

continuity.anchor: Una sola peça grossa, una tapa, una caixa i una galleda interior visible.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic dog; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. A través del frontal transparent de la caixa es veu una galleda baixa a sota de la peça. Continuity and accounting: Una sola peça grossa, una tapa, una caixa i una galleda interior visible. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image.
